sources.quote: HAT-P-14b, officially named Sissi and also known as WASP-27b, is an extrasolar planet located approximately 224.2 ± 0.6 parsecs (731.2 ± 2.0 ly) away in the constellation of Hercules, orbiting the 10th magnitude F-type main-sequence star HAT-P-14.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Stassun et al. 2017.
